Founded in 1990, it provides [[information technology]] and [[software engineering]] services.{{cite web |title=Persistent Systems Ltd |url=https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/xnse/persistent/quote |website=Morningstar, Inc. |access-date=22 April 2024 |language=en |date=19 April 2024}} ==History== [[File:PSPL-Erandwane-Pune.jpg|right|thumb|Persistent's Pingala-Aryabhata campus in [[Pune]]]] Persistent Systems was founded in 1990 by Anand Deshpande, a former [[Hewlett-Packard]] employee, with an investment of $21,000. In 2000, [[Intel Capital]] invested $1 million in the company for a 3.5% stake.{{cite news |last1=Sonavane |first1=Ravindra N. |title=Persistent's Deshpande joins club of billionaires |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/people/persistent-systems-cmd-anand-deshpande-turns-billionaire-11630639832997.html |access-date=22 April 2024 |work=mint |date=3 September 2021 |language=en}} In 2005, Persistent raised $18.8 million from [[Norwest Venture Partners]] and Gabriel Venture Partners.{{cite news |title=Persistent gets $18.8 million VC funding |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/technology/persistent-gets-18-8-million-vc-funding-105120801100_1.html |access-date=22 April 2024 |work=Business Standard}} Persistent Systems was listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] and [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] in March 2010 after its [[initial public offering]].{{Cite news|url=https://in.reuters.com/article/idINIndia-47067220100319|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191022104106/https://in.reuters.com/article/idINIndia-47067220100319|url-status=dead|archive-date=22 October 2019|title=Persistent Systems IPO subscribed 93.3 times|date=2010-03-19|work=Reuters|access-date=2019-10-22|language=en}} In 2014, Persistent Systems incorporated Accelerite, a wholly owned subsidiary based in [[Silicon Valley]], as its software products arm.{{Cite news|date=2014-03-19 |title=Persistent Systems introduces Accelrite to focus on product portfolio |work=Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/software/persistent-systems-introduces-accelrite-to-focus-on-product-portfolio/articleshow/32312934.cms |access-date=2021-03-04}}{{Cite web |title=Persistent Systems buys two cloud products from Citrix |url=http://telecom.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/persistent-systems-buys-two-cloud-products-from-citrix/50544683 |access-date=2019-10-22 |website=ET Telecom |language=en}} In 2016, Persistent Systems launched a specialized engineering service for [[IBM Watson]] [[Internet of Things|IoT]] platform.{{Cite news |last=Sangani |first=Priyanka |date=2016-03-17 |title=Persistent Systems launches specialised engineering services for IBM Watson IoT platform |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/internet/persistent-systems-launches-specialised-engineering-services-for-ibm-watson-iot-platform/articleshow/51431109.cms |access-date=2019-10-22}} In 2019, Persistent joined [[Siemens]]' [[MindSphere]] partner program to deliver [[industrial internet of things]] (IIoT) services.{{Cite news |date=3 May 2019 |title=Persistent Systems joins Siemens'
